about: The hit of a boss's floor attack (fmLash and every *Hit*: a whip crack, a slam, a spear, a sack burst): a burst of white-hot fire and rock from the ground, tinted per boss.
name: Eruption

burst.png.prompt: Paint a burst of white-hot fire erupting straight up out of the ground: a fan of flame and bright sparks and small chunks of glowing rock flying up from one point at the bottom, wider at the top. Pure light, nothing solid. Plain flat pure black background (#000000), no floor, no scenery, centered with plenty of empty black space around it. Dark fantasy video game effect art, painterly, glowing.
